modes_not_implemented: dispatch: needs a collector, which is Gate 161
advance_schedule: needs a real source check, which no gate has built
the_order: evaluate the trigger against the last served slot
acquire the cycle for this slot, atomically, or refuse
run Gate 156 into Gate 158 in evaluate_and_enqueue mode
run Gate 157 over the persisted backlog
release the cycle, recording what it did
what_the_orchestrator_adds: ordering, exclusivity and recovery. It adds no capability to the three gates it calls: after a cycle the same sources are blocked for the same reasons.
